title: Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!
edition: 2015 animated special directed by Mitch Schauer, Disney+ edition
synopsis: Loki and Ymir seek Santa’s power. As the Avengers search for him, Rocket hopes a paying job will help him buy another ship.
verdictRationale: Rocket talks about what the trip could buy him. His passenger describes someone who spends the whole year preparing gifts for children. That exchange gives generosity a concrete cost. Elsewhere, the heroes frighten an innocent Santa look-alike, and his distress supplies a gag. The holiday adventure gives both service and careless treatment of others room on screen.
ageRationale: Slapstick kicks and fantasy weapons accompany the search. A frightened man is carried away in a sleigh by people he cannot stop. That loss of control may bother a young child even though the action has little injury detail.
reflection: Mrs. Claus measures Santa’s giving in the months of preparation that children never see. A family preparing for the Nativity might name one quiet act of service someone has already done for them this week.

title: Marvel Rising: Secret Warriors
edition: 2018 animated television feature premiered September 30 on Disney Channel and Disney XD
synopsis: Kamala and Doreen encounter Dante stealing food. Victor claims he protects people with powers, but he takes Kamala captive when she refuses to join him.
verdictRationale: Hala threatens two families to make her prisoners fight. Kamala and Dante refuse to treat one another as enemies and get the other prisoners out. The film lets Kamala revise her judgment of the boy she first saw stealing, while showing how Victor exploits a young person’s desire to belong.
ageRationale: Repeated fights include fire and energy weapons. The more difficult sequence for some children may be Hala threatening the captives’ families so the teenagers will hurt each other.
reflection: Kamala has a real reason to distrust Dante after the theft. In captivity she learns something that their first encounter could never have told her. Her willingness to see him anew makes it possible for both of them to protect someone else.
